description: This file implements Bluetooth module setup and communication procedures, including thread management, command execution, and initialization routines for different Bluetooth modules such as HC-05, HC-06, and SPP. It handles configuration parameters, thread synchronization, and message logging for Bluetooth setup.

methods.name: runCommands
methods.description: Executes commands to initialize and communicate with the Bluetooth module, handling baud rate changes, command sending, and response validation.

methods.name: btThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread entry point function that manages the Bluetooth setup procedure and waits for user actions.

methods.name: bluetoothStart
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth communication parameters, prepares command sequences based on module type, and creates the thread to perform setup.

methods.name: bluetoothSoftwareDisconnectNotify
methods.description: Notifies the thread to resume communication with the Bluetooth module after disconnection.

methods.name: bluetoothCancel
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing Bluetooth setup procedure, terminating the thread if necessary.
